To find the "typical value" of a dataset with a severe outlier (like 900 in this case), the median is the most appropriate measure of central tendency because it is not skewed by extreme values. 

Confidence level: 95%

```python
import statistics

def typical_value(data):
    """
    Returns the median as the typical representative value of the dataset,
    formatted as a string rounded to 2 decimal places.
    """
    median_val = statistics.median(data)
    return f"{median_val:.2f}"
```
